name: rennf93/symfony-guard
description: Symfony middleware adapter for guard-core-php: maps Symfony HttpFoundation requests to the guard-core engine and block verdicts back to Symfony responses

suggest.rennf93/guard-agent-php: Telemetry agent: ships security events and metrics to the Guard Core App and delivers dynamic rules (pass it as the agentHandler argument)

scripts.lint: for f in $(find src bin -name '*.php'); do php -l "$f" > /dev/null || exit 1; done && echo LINT_OK
